prompt: If your dog leaves muddy prints in the lift or on the shared stairs, please clean the floor before going upstairs. → Should …
answer: Should your dog leave muddy prints in the lift or on the shared stairs, please clean the floor before going upstairs.
accepted_answers: Should your dog leave muddy prints in the lift or on the shared stairs, please clean the floor before going upstairs.
explanation_ru: В формальной инверсии первого типа союз if опускается, Should выносится в начало, а основной глагол стоит в начальной форме без окончания -s (leave).

prompt: If the caller had not asked for a bank code, Deniz's grandfather would have believed the fake police story. → Had …
answer: Had the caller not asked for a bank code, Deniz's grandfather would have believed the fake police story.
accepted_answers: Had the caller not asked for a bank code, Deniz's grandfather would have believed the fake police story.
explanation_ru: В отрицательной инверсии третьего типа вперёд выносится только Had, а частица not остаётся строго после подлежащего.

prompt: If customers were to arrive without a reusable bag, our farm shop would charge a small fee for a paper one. → Were …
answer: Were customers to arrive without a reusable bag, our farm shop would charge a small fee for a paper one.
accepted_answers: Were customers to arrive without a reusable bag, our farm shop would charge a small fee for a paper one.
explanation_ru: Для маловероятного условия во втором типе используется инверсия Were + подлежащее + to + инфинитив без союза if.

prompt: Anika would have exchanged her ticket before Friday if she had seen the notice about the cancelled evening show. → Had …
answer: Had Anika seen the notice about the cancelled evening show, she would have exchanged her ticket before Friday.
accepted_answers: Had Anika seen the notice about the cancelled evening show, she would have exchanged her ticket before Friday.
Had Anika seen the notice about the cancelled evening show, she'd have exchanged her ticket before Friday.
explanation_ru: В инверсии третьего типа Had ставится перед подлежащим Anika, после чего следует третья форма глагола (seen).

prompt: Please email our Bristol manager directly if you wish to move your table booking while the kitchen is closed for repairs. → Should …
answer: Should you wish to move your table booking while the kitchen is closed for repairs, please email our Bristol manager directly.
accepted_answers: Should you wish to move your table booking while the kitchen is closed for repairs, please email our Bristol manager directly.
explanation_ru: Официальное объявление использует Should you wish вместо if you wish, ставя придаточное условия в начало предложения.

prompt: If new patients do not register on the clinic website before arriving, they will have to wait at the front desk. → Should …
answer: Should new patients not register on the clinic website before arriving, they will have to wait at the front desk.
accepted_answers: Should new patients not register on the clinic website before arriving, they will have to wait at the front desk.
Should new patients not register on the clinic website before arriving, they'll have to wait at the front desk.
explanation_ru: При отрицательной инверсии с Should частица not ставится после подлежащего перед основным глаголом, а do исчезает.

prompt: You must bring two written references and a photo ID if you intend to apply for the evening shift. → Should …
answer: Should you intend to apply for the evening shift, you must bring two written references and a photo ID.
accepted_answers: Should you intend to apply for the evening shift, you must bring two written references and a photo ID.
explanation_ru: В формальных требованиях о работе условную часть с if заменяют на Should you + инфинитив без to.

prompt: Create an inverted sentence about the airport bus.
answer: Had we not read the notice, we would have missed it.
accepted_answers: Had we not read the notice, we would have missed it.
explanation_ru: В отрицательной инверсии третьего типа порядок слов строго фиксирован: Had + подлежащее + not + третья форма глагола.

prompt: Reconstruct the friend's advice to Hyunwoo.
answer: Were you to pick the shorter report, you would finish sooner.
accepted_answers: Were you to pick the shorter report, you would finish sooner.
explanation_ru: Чтобы инвертировать глагол действия во втором типе, используют модель Were + подлежащее + to + глагол.

prompt: Assemble the sentence about the lost market bag.
answer: Had she checked the bench earlier, she would have found it.
accepted_answers: Had she checked the bench earlier, she would have found it.
explanation_ru: Нереальное условие в прошлом без if начинается с Had + подлежащее + V3, а результат выражен через would have + V3.

prompt: Oskar's knee hurts after every match. "(I / to be) in your place, I would rest and see a doctor before Sunday's cup game," his teammate said.

accepted_answers: Were I

explanation_ru: Перед пропуском нет союза if, поэтому нужна инверсия второго типа; в ней всегда используется только форма Were, а не Was.

prompt: Dark clouds rolled over the Scottish ridge so fast that we got soaked; (we / to listen) to the guide earlier, we would have reached the car dry.

accepted_answers: had we listened
Had we listened

explanation_ru: Главная часть would have reached указывает на нереальное прошлое, а отсутствие if требует инверсии had + подлежащее + V3.

prompt: My puppy destroyed three pairs of trainers in Nicosia; (my friend / not / to recommend) a patient dog trainer, I would have lost every shoe in the house.

accepted_answers: had my friend not recommended
Had my friend not recommended
Hadn't my friend recommended

explanation_ru: В отрицательной инверсии третьего типа had ставится перед подлежащим my friend, а not остаётся перед смысловым глаголом recommended.

prompt: ___ an appointment with the optician in Mexico City sooner, Leticia would not have suffered from daily headaches this autumn.
explanation_ru: Для третьего типа в инверсии нужен Past Perfect (Had she booked); нельзя использовать Did, добавлять would в условие или оставлять if.

prompt: The senior mechanic paused by the open bonnet and told the young apprentice, "___ for one more month, you would pick up skills no warehouse job offers."
explanation_ru: Во втором типе инверсия с глаголом действия строится по схеме Were + подлежащее + to + глагол; сочетать её с if, would или will нельзя.

prompt: Jiyeon handed the shy pupil a clean sheet of paper and said, "___ nervous before your talk in class, look down at the short notes you wrote."
explanation_ru: После Should сразу следует подлежащее и инфинитив без to (Should you feel); типичные ошибки — добавлять will, if или частицу to.

prompt: Yannis checked the lab door in Žilina and realised that ___ the testing notice, he would have ruined his Friday experiment.
explanation_ru: В отрицательной инверсии третьего типа частица not всегда стоит после подлежащего (had he not seen), а не перед ним.

prompt: According to the new sports centre notice Pavel read in Minsk, should members will wish to swim before eight, they must bring their own towel.
answer: According to the new sports centre notice Pavel read in Minsk, should members wish to swim before eight, they must bring their own towel.
accepted_answers: According to the new sports centre notice Pavel read in Minsk, should members wish to swim before eight, they must bring their own towel.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — ставить will после should; модальный глагол should сам требует голого инфинитива wish.

prompt: Had not the tired driver noticed Sergio's sign near Košice, he would have reached the motorway fuel pumps after ten o'clock.
answer: Had the tired driver not noticed Sergio's sign near Košice, he would have reached the motorway fuel pumps after ten o'clock.
accepted_answers: Had the tired driver not noticed Sergio's sign near Košice, he would have reached the motorway fuel pumps after ten o'clock.
explanation_ru: В инвертированном условии отрицание not нельзя выносить перед подлежащим: верно Had the tired driver not noticed.

prompt: If were I as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I would arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
answer: Were I as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I would arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
accepted_answers: Were I as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I would arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
Were I as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I'd arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
If I were as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I would arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
If I were as nervous about boarding at Pisa airport as you are, I'd arrive three hours early and sit quietly near the gate.
explanation_ru: Инверсия заменяет союз if, поэтому писать вместе If were I нельзя: нужно либо убрать If, либо вернуть прямой порядок If I were.

prompt: Had the student followed Lei's advice in La Paz and checked the exam room number the night before, he would have arrived completely calm.
answer: Had the student followed Lei's advice in La Paz and checked the exam room number the night before, he would have arrived completely calm.
accepted_answers: Had the student followed Lei's advice in La Paz and checked the exam room number the night before, he would have arrived completely calm.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: Had the student followed ... and checked — правильная инверсия третьего типа, согласованная с would have arrived.

prompt: Tadhg is a new intern in Kaohsiung who does not know how to begin a long report. A senior colleague wants to give him formal advice about what to do.
options: Had I been in your place, Tadhg, I would have written the short summary before anything else.
Were I in your position, Tadhg, I would write the short summary before starting the main sections.
Should I be in your position, Tadhg, I will write the short summary before the main sections.
If were I in your position, Tadhg, I would write the short summary before starting the main sections.
explanation_ru: Совет относится к текущей ситуации, поэтому подходит инверсия второго типа Were I in your position; первый вариант о прошлом, а четвёртый содержит лишнее If.

prompt: A beginner cook in Swansea skipped the top line of a cake recipe and put the tin into a cold oven, so the cake stayed flat.
options: Should the cook preheat the oven for twenty minutes, the cake will rise properly in the tin.
Were the cook to preheat the oven for twenty minutes, the cake would rise nicely in the tin.
Had the cook preheated the oven for twenty minutes, the cake would have risen properly instead of staying flat.
Had the cook skipped the first line, the cake would have risen properly instead of staying flat.
explanation_ru: Ситуация уже произошла в прошлом, поэтому нужна инверсия третьего типа Had the cook preheated; в последнем варианте нарушен порядок слов с not.
